corrected_draft_findings: Original accepted:false rollback-review.json and both drafts preserved. Canonical final script journals before/after each mutation and catches mutation, post-validation, host-check and output-construction exceptions with observed state plus STOP/narrow manual completion guidance.
Final-script Git reads bounded60s, mutations120s. Post-mutation live-ref failure goes through failure recorder. No broad automatic reset/recovery.
limitations: Process termination or filesystem failure can prevent exception recording; beforeimages and candidate branch are retained. A timeout/failure requires stopping and reviewing exact state, never blindly rerunning.

Review acceptance is confined to the exact reversible rollback control. Existing production qualification rejection remains in force. No Julia execution, source/test edit, ref mutation or push performed by reviewer.
scope: Independent rollback-only pre-execution review; does not qualify candidate for production or authorize push
transaction_review: Prechecks require rejected production candidate, exact final-script review hash, protected user files and both index hashes, all853pins/tree memberships, candidate local master/backup, sole parent235, live/tracking master235 and unchanged diagnostic refs.

Owned four paths have no staged changes; complete candidate src/test equals GREEN. Exclusive original index and all4source beforeimages precede detach/CAS/switch. Hooks disabled on switches, CAS supplies expected old candidate, no force switch/reset/clean/push.

Successful outcome requires baseline src/test tree, protected user files, unrelated index entries/staged raw diff/untracked membership, unchanged diagnostic index and exact candidate backup source blobs.

Partial transaction is recoverable, not automatically atomic: retained branch/index/source beforeimages and step records allow separately reviewed completion. Failed validation never establishes successful rollback.
